form.title: Customers not receiving password reset emails
form.impact: Password reset and order confirmation emails are delayed by 15+ minutes or never arrive.
form.details:
Support has a spike in tickets about missing password reset emails over the last half hour.
No code was deployed. Marketing launched the spring sale campaign this afternoon.

expected_cause: The bulk campaign exhausted the mailrelay quota (429s); bulk and transactional mail share one queue, so resets wait behind it.
